topic: Environmental Valuation Methods and Techniques
questionText:
Match the non-market environmental valuation technique in List I with its operational methodology in List II:

List I:
(A) Contingent Valuation Method (CVM)
(B) Hedonic Pricing Method
(C) Travel Cost Method (TCM)
(D) Replacement Cost Method

(II) Revealed preference technique inferring environmental value from property price differentials reflecting air quality or noise

detailedSolution:

According to NCERT principles for Environmental and Natural Resource Economics (Environmental Valuation Methods and Techniques):

options.text: The complete elimination of 100% of all radioactivity from the universe
